question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

Similarly Sirius, the most (**luminous**) star in all the heavens, actually has a faint companion.
solution:
The correct answer is **"gloomy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence describes Sirius as the most luminous star in all the heavens.
 
• **"Luminous"** means emitting light or shining brightly. (अँधेरे में चमकने वाला)
 
 
• **Example**: *This is **luminous**__ watch.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **luminous** is **gloomy.**
 
• It means **dark or dim**. (ऐसा गहरा कि उदास कर दे)
 __
 
• **Example**: *This dark paint makes the room very **gloomy**__.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym to substitute the word** 'luminous'** in the given sentence is **gloomy**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, excited**: This word means feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm. It is not an antonym of luminous. (उत्तेजित, व्‍यग्र; अधीर)
 
• **Option 2, miserable**: This word means feeling or showing extreme unhappiness. It is not an antonym of luminous. (बहुत उदास, दयनीय)
 
• **Option 3, serious**: This word means showing deep thought or concern. It is not an antonym of luminous. 9दुर्दशाग्रस्‍त; बुरी हालत या ख़तरनाक या चिंताजनक)
